theme.title: Stars and Surprises
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: How many points did Michael Jordan score in Game 4 of the 1993 Finals against Phoenix?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In Game 4, Michael Jordan was unstoppable, scoring 55 points at Chicago Stadium

funFacts.text: Jordan faced reigning league MVP Charles Barkley, who had lifted the Suns to the league's best record.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: winners of 62 games and led by regular season MVP Charles Barkley

funFacts.text: Scott Williams joked that he and fellow North Carolina alumnus Jordan had combined for an absurd scoring total.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Scott Williams, who like MJ played his college basketball at UNC

funFacts.text: Earlier in the series, Phoenix had won a marathon triple-overtime game at Chicago Stadium.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Phoenix Suns won Game 3 in triple overtime

questions.prompt: How many career triple-doubles did Oscar Robertson record?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: For his career, Robertson had 181 triple-doubles, a record that had never been approached for decades

funFacts.text: Robertson played on the U.S. Olympic team in 1960 and later entered the Hall of Fame twice, including with that team.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: having been inducted in 1980 for his individual career, and in 2010 as a member

funFacts.text: The Big O became the first guard to average double-digit rebounds per game, accomplishing it three times.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the first guard in NBA history to ever average more than 10 rebounds per game

funFacts.text: Robertson finished his NBA career with Milwaukee, winning a championship alongside Kareem Abdul-Jabbar.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: For the first time in his career, Robertson had won an NBA championship

questions.prompt: Facing elimination at Oklahoma City in 2016, Klay Thompson set what was then the playoff record for threes. How many?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Klay Thompson made eleven three-pointers, breaking the NBA playoff record of nine.

funFacts.text: Golden State was facing elimination after the Thunder had built a commanding series lead.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: putting them down 1–3 in the Western Conference finals

funFacts.text: All three of Curry, Thompson and Green were named All-NBA during the tense Oklahoma City series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Stephen Curry, Draymond Green and Klay Thompson were named to the 2015–16 All-NBA Team

funFacts.text: The Warriors rallied to take the deciding game, but would later lose a Finals series after leading Cleveland.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: they defeated the Thunder 96–88

questions.prompt: How many of the 2014 Spurs' playoff wins came by 15 points or more?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Spurs finished the playoffs with 12 wins by 15 points or more, the most ever in the postseason.

funFacts.text: Kawhi Leonard won Finals MVP, becoming the youngest recipient since Magic Johnson.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: and the youngest since Magic Johnson in 1982

funFacts.text: Tim Duncan surpassed Kareem Abdul-Jabbar's all-time postseason minutes mark during the series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Duncan also eclipsed Kareem Abdul-Jabbar's previous mark

funFacts.text: Miami's other starters struggled as LeBron James tried to carry the offense on his own.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: their other starters combined for only 28 points on 32 percent shooting

questions.prompt: Oklahoma City made just five threes in the 2024 NBA Cup final. How many did it attempt?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: going 5-of-32 from long-range, setting season lows in both field goal and three-point percentage

funFacts.text: Milwaukee's 97–81 win gave the franchise its first NBA Cup title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Bucks won their first NBA Cup title

funFacts.text: Taurean Prince became the first player to win two NBA Cups, having won with the Lakers previously.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Taurean Prince, who won the 2023 title with the Los Angeles Lakers, became the first player to win multiple NBA Cups

funFacts.text: The 2024 tournament was the first with Emirates as the NBA Cup's naming sponsor.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the first year of a multiyear deal with the airline company Emirates
